pages.text: Two ordinary $(l:companions/combat)Combat Slimes$() share a body through $(l:world/colony_bonding)Colony Bonding$(). Health is combined; base Attack is 60% of their combined Attack values. Initial deployment and redeployment after recovery always start in Wait.
pages.title: Combat Slime Colony

pages.text: The first member supplies active weapons, shield and armor, including their wear. Both bodies display that armor's material, dye and glint. Member two's original equipment stays stored for unbinding. Each body keeps its own color and held-item appearance.

Damage and healing update both health records. Activity alternates between members. Point upgrades use member one; Creative stat edits affect both. Unbinding restores both identities, gear, cargo, growth and remaining stamina. Target settings initially copy member one.
